note: Episodes were run ahead of time with the SWARM simulator and are replayed in the browser. Nothing on this site runs a simulation.

episodes.title: Coordinated search
episodes.summary: Two drones and two ground robots share belief maps and divide the map into sectors with a lease auction, over a channel with an 8 / 5 cell range.

episodes.title: Independent search
episodes.summary: Same map and seed, but every robot explores on its own information only. Compare the time to the recall target with the coordinated run.

episodes.title: Faults and noisy sensing
episodes.summary: 20% message loss, 1-step latency with jitter, two scheduled robot failures, more hazards and a noisy sensor that misreads terrain and hazards.

episodes.title: Learned allocation (MAPPO)
episodes.summary: A sector-selection policy trained with MAPPO (Phase 4), run with NumPy inference. Same map and seed as the coordinated run.
